review_candidates.description: The Senior Network Engineer will lead the evaluation of enterprise network systems, recommend scalable architectural resources, and identify/deploy advanced networking products to optimize service levels across multisite environments. This role focuses heavily on SD-WAN, Zero Trust security models, LAN/Data Center infrastructures, and core routing architectures. The role supports standards for low-latency, high-performance networks in high-traffic retail and omnichannel environments, recommending continuous enhancements for security, mobility, and access while serving as an escalation point for complex network issues and mentoring junior team members. This role is located in Springfield MO, remote work not an option Responsibilities And Duties Core Network & SD-WAN Optimization: Drive advances in SD-WAN, core routing, and switching architectures to increase the value delivered by enterprise network capabilities, improving environment efficiency and lowering total cost of technology operations. Data Center & LAN Infrastructure: Design, select, and manage business-critical LAN, Data Center, and client/server network environments in line with industry best practices; provide third-line point of escalation for global network infrastructure solutions. Zero Trust & Security Integration: Implement and enhance Zero Trust network access (ZTNA) frameworks, micro-segmentation, and security measures (e.g., next-gen firewalls, secure access service edge/SASE, and message encryption) to safeguard high-traffic, multisite connectivity. Technical Architecture & Evaluation: Discuss and recommend technical developments to improve the quality, security, and scalability of core network routing, LAN/Data Center environments, and supporting digital infrastructure to better meet business needs. Requirements & Performance Testing: Collect network and business requirements through interviews, workshops, and traffic/workflow analysis; perform network software/hardware testing, monitoring performance, and diagnosing complex latency or bottleneck issues. Emerging Technology Research: Explore and develop a detailed understanding of emerging networking technologies (such as advancements in SD-WAN protocols, Zero Trust tools, and cloud routing) to evaluate their potential impact on the organization. Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution: Provide fault isolation, deep-packet analysis, and root-cause resolution for complex core network, routing, and multisite SD-WAN challenges to limit downtime and ensure operational continuity. Engineering Standards & Process Migration: Draft engineering standards, routing policies, and configuration specifications. Document "as-is" and "to-be" network states and execute migration plans to transition to modernized network capabilities. Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Mentor associate and mid-level network engineers on complex troubleshooting, such as resolving wide area network (WAN) bottlenecks in high-priority, revenue-generating systems. On-Call & Operational Support: Participate in an on-call rotation and provide flexible, rapid response to critical network outages or urgent security incidents to maintain system availability. Continuous Capability Development: Maintain an in-depth understanding of core routing, Zero Trust, and LAN/WAN technologies, external regulations, and industry best practices through ongoing training, certifications, and specialist media. Skills Required: SD-WAN Architecture & Operations: Manages, configures, and optimizes SD-WAN overlays and underlays across multisite networks to ensure reliable, application-aware routing and high availability. Zero Trust Security Strategy: Identifies, designs, and enforces Zero Trust network access control, micro-segmentation, and identity-driven access policies across the enterprise. LAN & Data Center Networking: Oversees the design, deployment, and ongoing management of high-density Data Center fabrics, switching, leaf-spine architectures, and local area networks (LAN). Core Network & Routing Mastery: Demonstrates advanced knowledge of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), WAN transport strategies, and traffic engineering in complex hybrid environments. Network Scalability & Performance Management: Identifies appropriate measures for assessing network performance, validates metrics with key stakeholders, and implements optimizations for low-latency, high-traffic demands. Troubleshooting & Fault Isolation: Methodically analyzes complex network failures, diagnoses routing or latency anomalies, and executes swift remediations to minimize business impact. Technical Communication: Communicates and articulates complex network designs, security risks, and technical strategies in a clear, compelling manner tailored to both technical teams and leadership. Risk Management & Security Compliance: Plans, identifies, and prioritizes network vulnerabilities and operational risks; develops proactive response plans to mitigate network and security threats. Change Management: Identifies, verifies, and manages changes to enterprise network scope and infrastructure configurations using structured change management procedures. Project Sequencing & Resource Execution: Organizes, schedules, and prioritizes infrastructure implementations and upgrades to ensure timely project delivery without business disruption. review_candidates.description: The Role Moderna is expanding our footprint to deliver the greatest possible impact to people through mRNA medicines. Our technology hub server team is responsible for the design, implementation, administration, and support of the server environments supporting our research and pharmaceutical production. This role requires deep expertise in engineering and supporting a multi-distro enterprise Linux environment. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical expert who excels in troubleshooting, automation, and system optimization to ensure stability, scalability, and security across enterprise systems. We are seeking experienced engineers who embody the Moderna Mindsets and want to help transform patients’ lives by building reliable, secure, and scalable systems. Here’s What You Will Do Serve as a technical owner for enterprise Linux systems (Amazon Linux, Ubuntu, RHEL) across on-premises and cloud environments (VMware, AWS, Azure). Design, install, configure, and maintain Linux systems supporting research and production operations. Conduct root cause analysis and advanced troubleshooting for system, network, and authentication issues. Ensure high availability, scalability, and performance through configuration management and proactive monitoring Automate infrastructure operations using shell scripting, Ansible, Python, Terraform, or other IaC tools Integrate Linux systems with Active Directory (realmd, sssd, winbind); configure Kerberos, LDAP, NSS, and PAM; manage SPNs, keytabs, and TLS/SSL certificates. Support containerized environments leveraging Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes. Implement and maintain storage solutions (LVM, iSCSI, NFS) with a focus on performance and resilience. Partner with cybersecurity teams to ensure compliance with Moderna’s security and incident response software suite. Contribute to monitoring and observability efforts using tools such as Prometheus, Dynatrace, or Splunk. Develop server and application implementation plans, custom scripts, and testing procedures to ensure operational reliability. Maintain accurate documentation, diagrams, and system inventories. Participate in on-call rotation and respond to escalated support incidents. Here’s What You’ll Need (Basic Qualifications) Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). 3–5 years of professional experience supporting Linux in a mixed OS environment Strong understanding of multiple Linux distros including all core services/daemons Proven ability to troubleshoot system, network, and performance issues. Experience with patch management process and tooling, endpoint protection, compliance and server hardening. Familiarity with hybrid multi-cloud environments and virtualization technologies. Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills, including working across global teams. Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications) Linux certifications such as RHCSA/RHCE, LFCS/LFCE, or LPIC. Industry certifications: AWS, CISSP, CISM, ITIL. Experience in regulated or security-sensitive environments (e.g., GxP, DISA-STIG, CIS, PCI). Ability to work independently, develop long term strategic Infrastructure enterprise goals. Pay & Benefits At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between. Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown Savings and investments to help you plan for the future Location-specific perks and extras The salary range for this role is $109,200.00 - $174,600.00.
